why_it_fails: Baseline is SUSPICIOUS_DROP at 341 items. The sampler reads page size as the declared total, so its result is not usable. Not established whether the drop is real or the /discounts path is a subset.
fix_idea: Take the total from the GetProductList response and compare. If /discounts is a subset, read the base recreational menu path instead.
